purpose: Stage 1/2 frozen-checkpoint diagnostics; no training and no adaptive model selection
scope: Synthetic known continuous cosine fields and retrospective barbara case. All synthetic content is outside natural-image training distribution; rectangular and zero-cell queries are outside isotropic training support. Phase split is a bounded diagnostic, not a natural-image generalization test or an observation-only deployment claim. Analytical amplitudes/target laws are known; oracle forecast uses their scoring truth. No first-integration or new theorem claim.
input_operator: Unit-domain box averages on n*n midpoint grid, noiseless, exact analytic sinc; fixed per input/case across every target and hint
quadrature: Final RGB point-limit field midpoint integration. Numerical approximation, not exact integration guarantee; save both refinements. Native area condition changes while encoder, coordinates, weights and observation remain fixed.
natural_protocol: Known negative example only: center HR256, torch bicubic antialias LR sizes128/64, no noise; full vs point-limit same-weight, and inherited separately retrained ablations. Both raw and clamped, RGB-mean FFT square annuli. No new unseen-test claim; target is discrete HR, not certified box truth.
prediction_freeze: All synthetic and natural predictions saved and SHA cohort frozen before truth scoring. Fixed models/no optimization/no parameter selection. Preparation generates y and truth separately.
calibration: phase0 only for group-wise band-median and affine footprint-score fit; phase pi/2 for comparison; frequency/direction/target grid fixed, no test tuning
primary_metrics: signed normalized MSE effect native versus point
within-band rank and MAE versus band/footprint baseline
negative-effect recall restricted to |actual gain|>.001; active-effect scoring margin, no deployment abstention
exact squared-error change-energy/alignment decomposition; posthoc identity not predictive mechanism

decision_gates.prediction_candidate: MAE >=20% better than BOTH calibrated simple baselines in every model/input-size group, sign accuracy >=.75 and negative recall >=.75 where >=8 negative active cases; otherwise insufficient. This diagnostic does not itself authorize matched training.
decision_gates.integration: Report dimensionless discrepancy and convergence. Treat cases with refinement MSE >1e-5 OR refinement MSE >0.1 native/quadrature discrepancy as numerically unresolved for noncommutation claims.
decision_gates.stop: Only three-band ordering, only internal sinc identity, or advantages only on unsupported hints are insufficient; keep counterexamples. No new GPU or matched training in this stage.

resource.absolute_deadline: each new root records launch UTC+its fixed budget before preparation; external timeout at same duration; no resume or extension

retention: Preserve all failures/missing cases/raw outputs and frozen source. Source change requires archived version/new run root, never repair into frozen run.
source_change_from_v1: Disable MKLDNN CPU convolution backend following preserved preflight segmentation fault; mathematical forward/checkpoints/cohort unchanged
Implement predeclared quadrature-resolution flags and gate
